_doc: GENESIS texture pass. Groups: wall / roof / ground / landuse (16 layers each, tileable, 'm' = metres the tile covers), misc (water, clouds), ui (banners, cards, events, hero). Generated with GPT Image 2.5 (Higgsfield 'flare') at 2k; 'job' + 'ts' identify the Higgsfield result: https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_3EdDR1X9D9foMDc9Ifvh8eZytCQ/hf_<ts>_<job>.png
tile_prefix: Seamless tileable texture that repeats perfectly at all four edges. Orthographic view, flat even overcast daylight, no cast shadows, no vignette, no frame, no border, no text, no watermark, no objects or figures. Photorealistic PBR albedo (base colour) map, one consistent scale across the whole image, the pattern fills the frame edge to edge.

wall.p: Head-on view of a sun-dried mud brick wall with a thin coat of earthen plaster, warm tan, faint horizontal brick courses showing through, straw flecks, small cracks. Covers about 3 by 3 metres.
Head-on view of a smooth lime-washed plaster wall, pale cream, subtle mottling, hairline cracks, slight grime at the bottom edge only faintly. Covers about 3 by 3 metres.
Head-on view of rough hand-applied lime plaster (wattle-and-daub infill), bumpy off-white surface with trowel marks, no timbers visible. Covers about 3 by 3 metres.
Head-on view of a rubble fieldstone masonry wall, irregular grey-brown stones of mixed sizes with pale lime mortar joints. Covers about 3 by 3 metres.
Head-on view of an old red clay brick wall in English bond, worn bricks with natural colour variation, light grey mortar. Covers about 2 by 2 metres.
Head-on view of raw cast concrete wall panels, light grey, faint formwork lines and a grid of tie holes, light weather staining. Covers about 4 by 4 metres.
Head-on view of a modern office curtain wall: blue-grey reflective glass panels in a regular grid with slim dark aluminium mullions, reflecting a soft overcast sky. Covers about 4 by 4 metres.
Head-on view of a weathered vertical wooden plank wall, grey-brown boards with knots, grain and narrow gaps. Covers about 2.5 by 2.5 metres.
Head-on view of dressed limestone ashlar masonry, large smooth rectangular blocks in regular courses with fine joints, pale warm grey. Covers about 3 by 3 metres.
Head-on view of polished white marble cladding with soft grey veins, large panels with very fine joints. Covers about 3 by 3 metres.
Head-on view of an ochre-yellow London stock brick wall with light soot staining, Flemish bond, grey mortar. Covers about 2 by 2 metres.
Head-on view of a rammed-earth wall with horizontal stratified layers in red-brown and ochre, slightly eroded surface. Covers about 3 by 3 metres.
Head-on view of Inca-style polygonal dry-stone masonry, tightly fitted irregular grey andesite blocks with no mortar. Covers about 3 by 3 metres.
Head-on view of painted horizontal wooden clapboard siding, white paint slightly weathered and peeling, regular overlapping boards. Covers about 2.5 by 2.5 metres.
Head-on view of a corrugated galvanized iron sheet wall, vertical ridges, zinc grey with rust streaks and patches. Covers about 2 by 2 metres.
Head-on view of a golden sandstone block wall, medium-size blocks in courses, wind-worn surfaces, thin joints. Covers about 3 by 3 metres.

misc.p: Straight-down view of a deep blue ocean surface with small wind waves and ripples, no foam, no horizon. Covers about 20 by 20 metres.

ui_prefix: Painted matte illustration in a rich, cinematic strategy-game key-art style, warm golden-hour palette with deep shadows, highly detailed, no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no border.

ui.p: A band of Stone Age hunter-gatherers around a fire at dusk below a cliff painted with ochre animals, a mammoth herd crossing the plain beyond.
A Bronze Age river-valley city of mud brick with a great ziggurat at sunset, reed barges on the river, bronze-helmed guards at a gate.
An Iron Age hillfort with a timber palisade on misty green hills, a smith's forge glowing orange, warriors with iron swords and round shields.
A Classical marble temple on an acropolis above a harbour crowded with triremes, golden afternoon light, olive trees.
A Medieval walled town with a gothic cathedral and a castle keep, market day in the square, heraldic banners, autumn light.
A Renaissance city with a great dome and palazzos along a river crossed by a stone bridge, galleons at the quay, scholars and merchants.
An Industrial city of smoking factory chimneys with a steam locomotive crossing an iron bridge over a canal, soot-grey sky with a red sun.
A Modern skyline of glass towers at dusk, highways streaming with headlights, a jet airliner climbing overhead.
An Information Age metropolis at night: glowing towers, giant screens, drones, a rocket launching on the horizon under a sky of satellites.

A volcano erupting at night above a small town, rivers of lava and a towering ash column lit from below.
A great river in flood sweeping through fields and a village, people on rooftops, grey rain.
A plague-stricken medieval street at dusk, a cart with a lantern, shuttered houses, a lone masked physician.
A huge comet with a blazing tail over a sleeping ancient city at night, crowds pointing up.
An army with siege towers and banners assaulting the walls of a city at dawn, smoke and arrows.

Planet Earth seen from low orbit at dawn, the terminator line sweeping across continents, tiny points of firelight marking the first settlements, 10,000 BC, awe-inspiring.
